name: Longlink Module Cleaner
description: Longlink Module Cleaner addon module. Source of truth: tichm30/longlink-module-cleaner.
notes: Seeded scaffold. Build out src/, routes/, resources/, database/migrations/ per the governing brief (populate batch 0.1.0b).

owned_tables starts empty. Every table this module creates MUST be prefixed module_cleaner_ (host assertAddonOwnedTable rule) and MUST be added here - expected: cleanup logs, quarantine index, backup-set index.

Destructive removal goes through host purge primitives only (host repo lands them first; bump requires_host_min_version to that release). The cleaner orchestrates and audits; it never bypasses the forbidden-tables guard.
